title: Insurance
description: Adapt the review to the insurer, intermediary or software supplier and the insurance workflow in scope.
context: Identify the insurance line, jurisdiction, organisation's role and affected workflow, such as quotes, underwriting, distribution, policy servicing or claims.
Distinguish the policyholder, beneficiary, broker and insurer where relevant. Check what each can see and which decisions each can make.
Use synthetic records for examples. Ask the data owner about approved use of policyholder and claims data and the evidence to keep for reviews.
For changes to eligibility, pricing or claims, ask who approves the decision, how a customer can contest it and how the team can reconstruct it.
Ask the compliance owner which requirements apply in the named jurisdiction and which operational resilience, privacy or distribution controls cover the change.
